briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating US-China compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration on reasoning models while regulatory pressure mounts in the US and EU. Compute constraints remain the primary bottleneck for all players except those with sovereign backing.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced multi-step reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in long-context safety, while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B and DeepSeek unveiled R2 with competitive benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring for agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and xAI announce joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for 2027 while Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI-level system emerge from a US lab or a state-backed Chinese consortium before 2028?
